title: Continuous Curved 2D Spiral Manifold
intuition: Tests continuous curved probability mass (1.5-turn Archimedes spiral with radial noise sigma=0.08) rather than a finite table of point clusters, checking global sliced W1, mean, and covariance fidelity.
failure_mode: Overly rigid discrete prototype charts quantize the smooth spiral into beads or cut straight chords across inner turns.
